The goal isn't doing more, it's shipping the right things. In this video, a GitHub product manager shows how the GitHub Copilot app brings your work into one place, so you can stay in control, focus on the work that matters, and move it from issue to merge. See how features like plan mode and agent merge help you steer your agents, resolve CI failures, and land pull requests with confidence. 

Start building with the GitHub Copilot app today: https://github.com/features/ai/github-app?utm_source=youtube-github-copilot-app-trailer-1&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=github-copilot-app-tech-preview-2026
